links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM-extracted transfusion reaction features versus blinded physician reference assessments
links.effect: Precision above 0.98 for all models; sensitivity 0.774 (Kimi K3), 0.636 (GPT-OSS-120B), 0.624 (Qwen 3.6-27B); specificity 0.952 to 0.991; omissions were over 94% of false negatives.
links.quote: Sensitivity was 0.774 (95% CI 0.745–0.800) for Kimi K3, 0.636 (0.604–0.667) for GPT-OSS-120B, and 0.624 (0.593–0.655) for Qwen 3.6-27B, and specificity ranged from 0.952 to 0.991.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an open-source multi-agent LLM pipeline to extract transfusion reaction features from clinical notes, evaluated offline by physicians on retrospective/simulated notes.
